question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**including**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about **Dr. Jill Biden: First Lady.**
 
• In the first blank '**including**' should be used.
 
• It is used as a **preposition**. And in the given context it means 'having as a part'. (को शामिल करते हुए)
 
 
• *Example: It costs Rs 990, **including** postage and packing.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 2.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *Dr. Jill Biden is an English professor in a college and she has four degrees, **including** a doctorate. She is the wife of (2)________ newly elected U.S. President, Joe Biden. As (3)_______ next first lady, the 69-year-old Jill Biden (4)_________ to keep her job and continue teaching (5)_______ is something that she did as the second lady when her husband was the Vice President.*
